title: Substack article on the boxer upsets the wrestling community

tellings.quote: So, I wrote an article. I have a Substack, which I haven't done anything with in about a year, but I have a Substack. And I wrote an article about this particular event.

plain: An article about an event involving a boxer upset the wrestling community, according to the author Peter Levenda, who wrote it. He tells Michels he published it on his Substack, an online newsletter he says he hasn't touched in about a year, but he gives few details of what the event was.
